title: Measurement reduction in variational quantum algorithms
problem_summary: Uses unitary partitioning -- appending additional unitary operations to the ansatz preparation -- to reduce the number of Hamiltonian terms that must be separately measured. Proves linear term reduction (in orbital count) is always achievable for electronic structure Hamiltonians, and finds roughly an order-of-magnitude reduction in term count for 10-30 qubit systems.

components.notes: Additional unitary operations appended to ansatz state preparation reduce the number of separately-measured Hamiltonian terms.

components.family_or_name: asymmetric qubitization (for implementing the added unitary operations at lower circuit depth)

workflow_composition_notes: Measurement-reduction technique layered on top of a standard VQE loop's measurement stage; not a full ansatz/optimizer proposal in itself.
